main_text.p: 8 Dederunt, inquam filii Israel Leuitis vrbes has, & suburbana earum, sicut praeceperat Iehoua per manum Mosis, per sortem.
9 Dederunt ergo de tribu filiorum Iuda, & de tribu filiorum Simeon vrbes istas quas vocauit nomine.
10 Fuerúntque filiis Aaron de familiis Ceat, de filiis Leui: illis enim fuit sors prima.
11 Dederúntque eis Ciriath-arba patris Anac (ipsa est Hebron) in monte Iuda, & suburbana eius per circuitum eius.
12 Agrum vero eius vrbis & villas eius dederunt Caleb filio Iephune in possessionem eius.
13 Filiis, inquam, Aaron sacerdotis dederunt vrbe refugii homicidae, Hebron, & suburbana eius: & Libna, & suburbana eius:

page.notes: Printed page number is "259" (old-style figures, shown as 259). Ornamental/abbreviated forms such as "Iehoua", "Iephune" and "Ceat" are copied as printed. Lines 8 to 13 include some unclear letters in the scan, but were read as printed.
